phone.backup.why.title: Back up your memory every night, so a lost phone doesn’t lose it.
phone.backup.why.goes.label: What goes
phone.backup.why.goes: Everything you kept, locked. Each night, while this phone charges, only what changed goes.
phone.backup.why.who.label: Who can open it
phone.backup.why.who.ios: Only someone with your phrase. Apple keeps it in your iCloud but can’t open it, and neither can Nocturne’s makers.
phone.backup.why.who.android: Only someone with your phrase. Google keeps it in your Drive but can’t open it, and neither can Nocturne’s makers.
phone.backup.why.need.label: You need
phone.backup.why.need.ios: iCloud turned on, with room for about {size}.
phone.backup.why.need.android: Your Google account on this phone, with room for about {size} in its Drive.
phone.backup.why.barLine: Nothing is turned on until the last step.
phone.backup.blocked.signedOut.ios: Sign in to iCloud in Settings to back up.
phone.backup.blocked.turnedOff.ios: Turn on iCloud for Nocturne in Settings to back up.
phone.backup.blocked.noRoom.ios: Your iCloud has {free} free. Make room there first, or choose more storage in Settings.
phone.backup.blocked.noAccount.android: Add a Google account in your phone’s settings to back up.
phone.backup.blocked.refused.android: Nothing was turned on. Google didn’t allow it.
phone.backup.blocked.noRoom.android: Your Google Drive has {free} free. Make room there first, then choose Continue.
phone.backup.blocked.offline: This phone isn’t online. Backup needs the internet to start.
phone.backup.about.where.label: Where
phone.backup.about.where.ios: In your iCloud, in a place only Nocturne uses. It doesn’t show among your files.
phone.backup.about.where.android: In your Google Drive, in a folder called Nocturne backup. Nocturne can reach only what it puts there, nothing else in your Drive.
phone.backup.about.sees.label: What the company sees
phone.backup.about.sees: {company} can see that the backup is there, how big it is and when it changes. It can’t see what is in it.
phone.backup.about.when.label: When
phone.backup.about.when: Each night while this phone charges, at a time your phone chooses. Over mobile data too, unless you choose Wi-Fi only.
phone.backup.about.many.label: How many
phone.backup.about.many: You can go back up to seven nights. When you forget something for good, it goes from the backup at once.
phone.backup.about.private.label: Private things
phone.backup.about.private: Things you mark private are backed up too, locked like everything else. Private only keeps them out of notifications, reminders and the lock screen.
phone.backup.about.own.label: Your phone’s own backup
phone.backup.about.own: Your phone’s own backup leaves your memory out, so this is the one copy online.
phone.backup.about.newPhone.label: A new phone
phone.backup.about.newPhone.ios: Sign in with the same Apple Account, install Nocturne, choose {haveBackup}, and type your phrase.
phone.backup.about.newPhone.android: Install Nocturne, choose {haveBackup}, choose the same Google account, and type your phrase.
phone.backup.about.hasMemory.label: A phone that already has a memory
phone.backup.about.hasMemory: {restore} in {thisPhone} brings the backup’s things in. Nothing on the phone is put aside or deleted.
phone.backup.about.file.label: One file
phone.backup.about.file: To keep a copy somewhere else too, {saveBackup} in {thisPhone} saves everything as one file.
phone.backup.about.off.label: Turning it off
phone.backup.about.off: Turn it off in {thisPhone}. You then choose whether to delete the backup.
phone.backup.about.heading: About the backup
phone.backup.phrase.title: Your phrase for the backup
phone.backup.phrase.lead: It opens your backup on a new phone. Nocturne made this one up for you.
phone.backup.phrase.leadOwn: It opens your backup on a new phone.
phone.backup.phrase.label: Your phrase
phone.backup.phrase.ownHint: A few words that don’t go together are strong and easy to remember.
phone.backup.phrase.weak: This phrase is easy to guess. Someone who finds your backup could try it. Nocturne’s own phrase is harder to guess.
phone.backup.phrase.note.title: Keep this phrase safe
phone.backup.phrase.note: Nocturne doesn’t keep it. Without it, nobody can open your backup, not even Nocturne. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, or save it in a password manager.
phone.backup.phrase.typeToGo: Type a phrase to go on.
phone.backup.check.title: Type your phrase
phone.backup.check.lead: Type it from where you wrote it down or saved it, so you know you have it.
phone.backup.check.wrong: That isn’t the phrase. Check each word, or go back to see it again.
phone.backup.check.typeToGo: Type your phrase to go on.
phone.backup.wifi.off: Backups use mobile data too: about {size} the first time, then a little each night.
phone.backup.key.title: A recovery key, if you want one
phone.backup.key.body: If you ever lose your phrase, a recovery key opens your backup instead. Print it or save it, and keep it away from this phone.
phone.backup.key.label: Recovery key
phone.backup.newKey.title: Your new recovery key
phone.backup.newKey.body: It opens your backup if you lose your phrase. Print it or save it, and keep it away from this phone. An earlier key no longer works.
phone.backup.makeKey.title: Make a recovery key?
phone.backup.makeKey.body: A recovery key opens your backup if you lose your phrase. It is shown once. If you made one before, it stops working.
phone.backup.first.title: Backing up for the first time
phone.backup.first.note: You can use Nocturne while this runs. If it doesn’t finish now, it carries on tonight while this phone charges.
phone.backup.first.wifi: Waiting for Wi-Fi. It starts when this phone is on Wi-Fi.
phone.backup.done.title: Your memory is backed up.
phone.backup.done.after: From now on, each night while this phone charges.
phone.backup.hint.on.android: Last backup {day}, {time} · {size} in your Google Drive
phone.backup.hint.first: Backing up for the first time · {done} of {size}
phone.backup.hint.tonight: Last backup {day}, {time} · next tonight while this phone charges
phone.backup.hint.offKept.ios: Off · your backup from {day} is still in your iCloud
phone.backup.hint.offKept.android: Off · your backup from {day} is still in your Google Drive
phone.backup.hint.onAgain: On again, with the same phrase.
phone.backup.say.wifi: Wi-Fi only is on, so the backup waits until this phone is on Wi-Fi and charging.
phone.backup.say.wifi.action: Back up now over mobile data
phone.backup.say.noRoom.ios: There’s no room in your iCloud for tonight’s backup. Your last backup from {day} is still there.
phone.backup.say.noRoom.android: There’s no room in your Google Drive for tonight’s backup. Your last backup from {day} is still there.
phone.backup.say.signedOut.ios: This iPhone is signed out of iCloud, so the backup has stopped. Sign in to iCloud in Settings to carry on.
phone.backup.say.signedOut.android: The Google account your backup uses isn’t on this phone any more, so the backup has stopped.
phone.backup.say.noPermission.ios: iCloud is turned off for Nocturne, so the backup has stopped. Turn it on in Settings, under iCloud.
phone.backup.say.noPermission.android: Google no longer lets Nocturne back up. Choose the account again.
phone.backup.say.anotherAccount: Your earlier backup stays in the Drive of {account}. Delete it there if you no longer want it.
phone.backup.say.another: Another phone made a newer backup on {day}. This phone has stopped backing up, so nothing is overwritten.
phone.backup.say.another.action: Make this phone the one in use
phone.backup.say.newer: A newer Nocturne made the latest backup. Update Nocturne from {store} to carry on.
phone.backup.inUse.title: Make this phone the one in use
phone.backup.inUse.body: This phone’s next backup becomes the newest. The other phone stops when it next looks.
phone.backup.inUse.yes: Make this phone the one in use
phone.backup.changeAsk.title: Change the phrase?
phone.backup.changeAsk.body: Your old phrase stops opening the backup. A recovery key you saved still works.
phone.backup.off.title: Turn off backup?
phone.backup.off.body.ios: No new backups are made. The backup in your iCloud stays as it is until you delete it.
phone.backup.off.body.android: No new backups are made. The backup in your Google Drive stays as it is until you delete it.
phone.backup.off.deleteHint.ios: All seven nights go from your iCloud for good. Nobody can bring them back.
phone.backup.off.deleteHint.android: All seven nights go from your Google Drive for good. Nobody can bring them back.
phone.backup.card.none: No backup yet. If this phone is lost, what you kept goes with it.
phone.backup.delete.body.ios: Everything you kept, your journal, check-ins, calendar and health readings in Nocturne go from this phone for good. Your calendar and Health themselves aren’t touched. Your backup in your iCloud is deleted too. A backup file you saved elsewhere isn’t touched.
phone.backup.delete.body.android: Everything you kept, your journal, check-ins, calendar and health readings in Nocturne go from this phone for good. Your calendar and Health themselves aren’t touched. Your backup in your Google Drive is deleted too. A backup file you saved elsewhere isn’t touched.
phone.backup.delete.after.ios: Everything was deleted from this phone and from your iCloud.
phone.backup.delete.after.android: Everything was deleted from this phone and from your Google Drive.
phone.backup.delete.offline.ios: Everything was deleted from this phone. Your backup in your iCloud goes the next time this phone is online. If you remove Nocturne before then, delete it yourself in iCloud in Settings.
phone.backup.delete.offline.android: Everything was deleted from this phone. Your backup in your Google Drive goes the next time this phone is online. If you remove Nocturne before then, delete it yourself in your Google Drive.
phone.backup.where.title: Where is your backup?
phone.backup.where.refused: Google didn’t allow it, so Nocturne can’t look for your backup.
phone.backup.found.title: Bring back your memory
phone.backup.found.lead: Type the phrase for your backup.
phone.backup.found.leadKey: Type the recovery key for your backup.
phone.backup.found.wrong: That phrase doesn’t open this backup. Check each word, and try again.
phone.backup.found.wrongAgain: That phrase doesn’t open this backup. If you saved it in a password manager, copy it from there, or use the recovery key.
phone.backup.found.wrongKey: That recovery key doesn’t open this backup. Check each group of letters and numbers, and try again.
phone.backup.nights.title: Which night?
phone.backup.nights.lead: The newest is chosen unless you pick another.
phone.backup.none.ios: No backup found in this iCloud.
phone.backup.none.ios.body: Sign in with the Apple Account your old phone used.
phone.backup.none.android: No backup found in this Google account’s Drive.
phone.backup.none.icloudOff: Turn on iCloud in Settings to find your backup.
phone.backup.none.offline: This phone isn’t online. Finding your backup needs the internet.
phone.backup.getting.title: Bringing back your memory
phone.backup.getting.body: Keep Nocturne open until this finishes. If it closes, nothing on this phone changes, and what has come down is kept, so starting again carries on.
phone.backup.problem.room.title: There isn’t room to bring it back
phone.backup.problem.room.body: This phone needs about {needed} free and has {free}. Free some room, then try again.
phone.backup.problem.missing.title: Part of this backup is missing
phone.backup.problem.missing.body: Nocturne can’t bring it back safely, so nothing changed. An earlier night may be whole.
phone.backup.problem.newer.title: This backup is from a newer Nocturne
phone.backup.problem.newer.body: Update Nocturne from {store}, then try again. Nothing was changed.
phone.backup.problem.lost.title: Nocturne lost its way to your backup
phone.backup.problem.lost.ios: iCloud was turned off or signed out. Nothing on this phone changed.
phone.backup.problem.lost.android: Google stopped letting Nocturne in. Nothing on this phone changed.
phone.backup.restored.title: Your memory is back on this phone.
phone.backup.restored.body: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}}, every page and your journal.
phone.backup.restored.mind: Its mind stays off until you choose it again in {thisPhone}.
phone.backup.restored.sources: Your calendar and Health on this phone stay off until you turn them on again.
phone.backup.merge.title: Your backup has its own memory, and this phone has one too.
phone.backup.merge.lead: A phone holds one person’s memory, so the backup’s things join the one here.
phone.backup.merge.what: What was in the backup, with its journal, check-ins and pages, joins the memory on this phone. Nothing here is put aside or deleted. What is on both is kept once.
phone.backup.merge.room: This phone needs about {size} free for it and has {free}. Free some room here, then choose {bringThemIn}.
phone.backup.adding.title: Bringing in your backup
phone.backup.adding.adding: Adding them to the memory on this phone…
phone.backup.adding.body: Keep Nocturne open until this finishes.
phone.backup.adding.stopAsk: Stop bringing your backup in? Nothing changes on this phone.
phone.backup.adding.stopped: Stopped. Nothing changed on this phone.
phone.backup.merged.title: Your backup’s things are here.
phone.backup.merged.body: {things, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}}, {entries, plural, one {# journal entry} other {# journal entries}} and {checkins, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}} were added to the memory on this phone.
phone.backup.merged.same: {same, plural, one {# was already here, so it was kept once.} other {# were already here, so they were kept once.}}
phone.backup.inUseAsk.title: Make the backups from this phone?
phone.backup.inUseAsk.body: This phone now makes the nightly backup, with the same phrase. If your old phone turns up, it stops making them.
phone.backup.newPhrase.title: Make a new phrase
phone.backup.newPhrase.body: You opened your backup with the recovery key. Make a new phrase now, so you have one.
